title: Projective Methods for Mitigating Gender Bias in Pre-trained Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Intrinsic bias is evaluated using an enhanced version of the StereoSet dataset via BERT's Next Sentence Prediction (NSP) task, measuring probability differences between stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, and gender-swapped sentence pairs (quantified as 'Strength' and 'Distance' metrics). Downstream extrinsic bias is evaluated using a gender-occupation Natural Language Inference (NLI) test set, calculating a Fairness Score based on prediction parity (neutral predictions) across binary genders for different occupations.
